Maya (People Ops): Quick orientation kickoff checklist for managers — copy into your hire folder. Short & actionable. :rocket:

Diego (Hiring Manager): Nice. Call out analytics + billing as day-1 musts.

Maya (People Ops): Noted. Checklist: Day 0: payroll + tax forms, confirm laptop ship, set recurring 1:1s. Day 1 AM: team intros (30m) + expectations sync (15m). Day 1 PM: IT handoff for SSO, Slack, email, VPN, analytics read & billing read. Day 2: repo access, security attestation. Day 3: ship a tiny doc/bug for early win. EOW: finalize 30/60/90 and schedule skip-level.

Sasha (new manager): Prefer weekly 1:1s; will add biweekly retro. Also want billing access early.

Taylor (IT): DM corp email and I can pre-provision analytics + billing read. Quick SSH key steps:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sasha@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Paste pub key into Access Portal -> Tech Access. Tag #help-it if blocked.

Maya (People Ops): Templates (SSO): 30/60/90 + intro email in onboarding repo. Ping me to copy into your hiring folder.

onboard-bot: Reminder set: complete payroll paperwork (48h).
